reasoning: Dogfood re-proof run 2026-10-12 (agent 475b48cf bunker-mvp, auger HEAD e7a45f4). chaos-resource cell: FAIL "rc=1 under cap (cap=3145728KB child_saw=3145728 subshell_saw=3145728 parent_saw=unlimited): ERROR tests/test_openapi_parity.py !!!... stopping after 1 failures... ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'yaml'". The suite NEVER RAN under the cap — pytest collection failed on a missing module (DG-007) — yet the cell issued a product memory verdict. The harness already has the right contracts: native_runner_missing_cause (bunker-qa.sh:1231) covers only 'No module named (pytest|nose|unittest2)' and command-not-found for runner binaries; suite_deps_missing_cause (bunker-qa.sh:1224) matches only npm signatures (tests?/node_modules is missing | vitest cannot be resolved | Cannot find module | npm error). A python collection error for ANY other module (yaml, requests, httpx, ...) falls through every INFO/UNVERIFIED guard to the final FAIL branch. Fix direction: extend the python dep-missing signature to the generic 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named <X>' collection error (keep the runner distinction: runner missing = native_runner_missing UNVERIFIED; any module missing = suite_deps_missing UNVERIFIED 'missing test dependencies — suite NEVER RAN under the cap'), so cap-vs-suite is never conflated. Evidence: /tmp/dog-qa-1012/auger-agent.jsonl chaos-resource row; the same ModuleNotFoundError is the ci-pass root cause (DG-007).
foreman_note: Same class as QA-FOREMAN-2026-09-26 (pytest module-missing) — that fix covered only the runner itself, not the suite's imports.

title: P1 — auger tests/test_openapi_parity.py imports yaml but the repo declares dependencies=[] and requirements-dev.txt pins only pytest: the OpenAPI parity gate cannot run on any fresh machine (dev box passes only via PyYAML leaked from the Hermes venv)
reasoning: Dogfood re-proof run 2026-10-12 (dogfood lane, agent 475b48cf bunker-mvp, auger HEAD e7a45f4). Fresh-install OK (pip auger-0.2), toolchain bootstrap OK (venv+pytest), then ci-pass FAIL: 'ERROR tests/test_openapi_parity.py ... ModuleNotFoundError: No module named yaml ... 1 error in 0.10s'. Reproduced independently on the control host: a clean venv with pytest but no PyYAML gives the identical collection error; with PyYAML present the file passes 11/11 in 0.28s. The repo ships docs/openapi.yaml + tests/test_openapi_parity.py (AUG-066) and tests/gate.sh runs it, but pyproject.toml has dependencies=[] (auger.py is stdlib-only, which is correct for the library) and tests/requirements-dev.txt contains ONLY 'pytest>=8'. Every fresh machine (agent, clean venv, another contributor) fails the gate at collection. Fix direction: declare test deps properly — [project.optional-dependencies] test = [pytest, pyyaml] (or add pyyaml to tests/requirements-dev.txt) and have the battery's pytest bootstrap / gate install that set. Chaos-resource FAIL on the same run is the same root cause mis-graded (see DG-008). Evidence: /tmp/dog-qa-1012/ (agent rows auger-agent.jsonl, repro venv); control-host commands: python3 -m pytest tests/test_openapi_parity.py -q (Hermes venv, PyYAML 6.0.3 present) = 11 passed; venv without yaml = 1 collection error.
foreman_note: Same root cause graded chaos-resource FAIL (memory verdict on a suite that never ran) — fix DG-008 in the same pass.
